about_the_game:
Playtest Coming Soon! Thank you for your patience!!

Sometimes, you'd wished for excitement.

All was balanced in the world and you, a simple chicken living a peaceful life, couldn't ask for anything. That was until the Fowl Duck regime attacked.

With their self-proclaimed genetic superiority, they quickly gained air superiority and naval dominance. They now stand outside your door, ready to claim your land. They've been all but completely successful in their campaign, but they failed to realize what laid beyond this door, YOUR door—one to four tough mother cluckers.

Diverse Battleground, Unpredictable Adventures

Randomized warzones, game-changing loot, and flocks of enemies ensure no two battles are the same. Every breach is a surprise, providing an enjoyable experience every time.

Just remember to extract in time or your gains will be forfeit!

Shoot and Loot

Secure an area for previous loot—collectibles, experience, and trophies. You never know what, or who, you'll find. Bring your loot back home and use it to make a profit, upgrade your hero, or make your horde that more enviable.

Not what you needed? No problem! Each item can be used in multiple ways.

Create Your Weapons, Grow Your Way

With more than 51 weapon types, your bound to find one, two or 52 ways to unleash your will upon the pathetic duck army. What might start weak, will quickly grow into an unstoppable weapon of maximum duck-struction as you combine weapons to grow their strength.

Win the war your way. BAWK-cause you can!

Level Up, Force Up

It's rags to riches as you grow from being an innocent chicken into a mighty cockatrice. Each duck consumed fuels the ever-growing thunder in your chest as you branch into your final form with the array of choices provided to you each level up.

Finish the Fight, End the War

A long journey is ahead of you as you battle back the land your people so painfully lost. If you find the strength, you will cast these fowl beasts the duck of YOUR planet. Make it through the gauntlet and destroy every last duck you see.

name: Escape From Cluckov

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Any dual-core processor with SSE2 support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any graphics card or integrated chip that supports DirectX 10
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Not currently benchmarked.

short_description: Escape from Cluckov is a PVE cooperative looter shooter—in a chicken's world! Loot your foes, build your arsenal, and upgrade your character in the world of Cluckov. End the fowl Duck regime and show them you don't give a cluck.
